ordinaryAcquisition.hostBoundary: Six distinct fresh hosted job VMs; preserve host/browser/Node identities and never pool across hosts/orders. Exactly Node22.22.0, pinned Playwright Chromium binary, strict headless and no headed/storage fallback.
ordinaryAcquisition.perHostSchedule: Two excluded warmup pairs in initial then opposite order. Twelve measured A/B pairs alternate initial/opposite order. After pairs3,6,9,12 insert one unchanged A/C control pair, alternating AC/CA with the initial-order offset. Thus24 candidate observations +8 controls +4 excluded warmups per host.
ordinaryAcquisition.timing: Unchanged page file-input-change to post-UI import-complete monotonic endpoint. Fresh browser profile each observation, one complete pinned corpus, no phase tracing/screenshots/process sampling during ordinary import. Identical explicit bounded hash hook runs after existing restart/lookup/media validation; its work is excluded from the timing endpoint.
ordinaryAcquisition.media: Sampled media checks in every ordinary observation, followed by independent all-media A and B imports. No timing from exhaustive-media imports enters statistics.
ordinaryAcquisition.sourcePolicy: No retries, replacements, exclusions, extra blocks, trimmed tails or adapted flags. Stop on first failed required observation and preserve every attempted result.

statistics.resampling: 10000 complete-pair bootstrap draws with random.Random(897); resample paired indices jointly for millisecond differences and percent ratios, report sorted indices249 and9749 as descriptive95% bounds. Keep all raw pair vectors. No population-general confidence claim.

vndbAdvanceEachHost.controls: Both |median paired C/A percent| and |equal-work C/A percent| must be strictly less than half the smaller absolute candidate median-paired/equal-work percent saving.

nonTargetEachHost.controls: Both absolute median paired and equal-work C/A changes must be <=1%.

statistics.globalDecision: Both VNDB hosts and all four non-target cells must pass every semantic/source/memory gate. Any incomplete cohort, contrary equal-work result or failed control condition is inconclusive/hold regardless of a favorable statistic. A qualified timing pass may support a PR claim limited to these exact corpora/source/hosts; no pooling with d0 component results or PR977.

memory.sequence: After all ordinary and all-media observations, existing four-observation ABBA/BAAB instrumented memory schedule per host. Compose exact memory overlay with the same post-validation hash hook; import-window sampling gates remain unchanged and hash work is outside that interval.
memory.gates: Keep all existing process-tree PSS/private-byte coverage/scan-gap requirements, every observation qualified, median paired increase <=5%, maximum paired increase <=10% for both metrics. No observer-gap waiver.
memory.interpretation: Separate diagnostic memory screen, no timing contribution and no process-peak savings claim from operation counts.

orchestrationAmendment.reason: Root authorized independent prerequisites to avoid serial hosted queue delays before any browser acquisition.
orchestrationAmendment.verify: Run exact clean candidate full JavaScript/main-dev-test-bench TypeScript/CSS/HTML/Markdown/JSON/unit/options/current WASM rebuild/all-target build once.
orchestrationAmendment.globalPreflight: In a separate job, run current baseline and candidate full-media browser exports, bounded I/O and complete persisted decode tied to the current natural A6/B7 oracle. Its automatic import timings are retained but excluded.
orchestrationAmendment.ordinaryGate: All six fresh-host ordinary cells depend on successful completion of BOTH verify and globalPreflight, including evidence packaging.
orchestrationAmendment.perHostVndbPreflight: Each VNDB AB/BA cell additionally repeats its own mandated full A/B exports and full proof before warmups, in that cell's assigned initial order. Its per-arm files must match the global proof.
orchestrationAmendment.unchanged: Every numerical threshold, warmup/pair/control schedule, separate media and memory schedule, source identity, no-retry rule and proof requirement remains unchanged.
orchestrationAmendment.globalDecision: A workflow-level pass requires both prerequisites and all six cells. A partial, skipped, failed or held cell cannot qualify the product. Root independently audits complete retained observations before a PR claim.

toolingBoundary.strategy: Compare all selected A/B stock dev/perf/test/chromium/test/e2e tooling directly against exact baseline Git blobs; import and run stock validator/memory/fixture/host commands from A. Research checkout tooling is not assumed equal.
toolingBoundary.researchControlBinding: Actual clean research HEAD/tree and GITHUB_SHA plus the exact manifest/workflow/protocol/plan/control hashes before and after acquisition.
toolingBoundary.explicitOverlay: Only the identical checked post-endpoint layout hook, plus the existing identical memory markers during the separate memory phase. No product overrides or PR977 composition.
toolingBoundary.dependencyTree: Exact stock qualifier setup: shutil.copytree(..., copy_function=os.link, symlinks=True) creates a real top-level ignored node_modules directory. A focused temporary-Git test gates this setup; raw porcelain, diffs and generated-file hashes are retained before/after dependencies and release build. No source-ignore or restore exceptions.

artifactTransport.archive: Complete original evidence tree in tar.gz; SHA256 and size for every member, full read-back verification, original inventories rehashed after archive, archive SHA256/size retained.
artifactTransport.alwaysReport: Every attempted observation's original endpoint, source/layout/semantic receipt, all gate results and failed phase log tails are printed independently of artifact upload.
artifactTransport.priorFailure: Historical d0 component artifact upload rejected pipe-character OPFS filenames. This transport-only repair never reruns its unchanged timing cohort.

pendingGates: Latest glue Python syntax and Node/helper/packaging tests must execute on the hosted runner; source-only V8 parse is not a Node gate.
Exact current candidate complete repository gates.
Actual full-browser all-media term-file equality and complete cold decode.
All six fixed ordinary/media/memory cells and independent retained-result audit.

localOutage.executionEnvironment: Unavailable while final controls were authored and checkpointed.
localOutage.attemptedLocalRunnerPatch: Interrupted tool call; local write state unknown; no acquisition used it.
localOutage.fixtureMove: Root attempted a verified byte-preserving tmpfs-to-disk fixture move but no successful command receipt was returned. State unknown; no memory improvement or path change assumed.
localOutage.sourceOfTruth: These exact uploaded blobs and the frozen source manifest, not inaccessible possibly partial local files.

runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.reason: Attempt 3 stopped before any import because the natural inventory included esbuild dependency source paths from a shared local dependency layout, while clean hosted release builds use stock real dependency directories.
runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.admission: Exactly 18 known historical/current raw SHA-256 pairs and 645 predeclared byte spans. Reconstruct the complete historical file from unchanged hosted bytes, then require its exact prior hash. Any other byte or unknown path/hash pair fails.
runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.runtimeFiles: Do not rewrite any generated library, source, release package, or natural oracle. Preserve the clean stock dependency/build setup. Runtime manifests and all later source guards bind every actual hosted file hash.
runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.proofInterpretation: Zip and resvg, the mismatched generated libraries reachable in the natural component, have identical executable ASTs. Other changes are source comments, sourcemap sources paths and 70 esbuild CommonJS source-label method keys; diagnostic function names/stacks can differ. All non-label AST fields and all other sourcemap fields are identical. A/B/C browser arms use the same stock library bytes.
runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.validation: Run the 28 focused acceptance/mutation checks against the actual first stock-built ext/lib directory before setup acceptance. The shared source guard is used by setup and by the full browser verifier before/after decoding.
runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.unchanged: Product commits/trees, fixture bytes, Git cleanliness, exact package delta, full logical/physical/media/restart proof, all schedules/statistical/memory gates and no-retry rule are unchanged.
runtimeSourceBindingAmendment.sourceScope: These controls intentionally remain pinned to dcfc02a and 2c02336. Later develop changes, including #981, are outside this cohort; no result transfers to a rebased combination without separate validation.
